entries.rationale: The legacy artifact-state projection remains available for areas not migrated through the boundary. Final package ownership cleanup removes this import.
The source segmentation module uses the legacy instruction-ledger type until product semantic modules are relocated during package ownership cleanup.
The service source segmenter uses the legacy instruction-ledger compiler until product semantic modules are relocated during package ownership cleanup.
Planning question execution translates the existing typed provider error; the service-owned error and inference contract replace this in PR 6.
The service executes actual Structrr diff policy over exchanged snapshots, with code relocation to the service distribution scheduled for final package ownership cleanup.
The service reconstructs a service-owned snapshot and invokes the existing Structrr implementation. Moving the implementation into the service distribution is part of final package ownership cleanup.
The service validates the source manifest format while compiling actual diffs; the private type moves with the Structrr service implementation during final package ownership cleanup.
Planning uses the existing bounded provider retry helper until provider and inference ownership moves in PR 6.
The planning question runner consumes the existing provider protocol until the service inference contract replaces it in PR 6.
